# `native-23-absent` Chart Reference Fixtures

Unmodified copies of the PowerPoint and WPS Presentation reference decks from `@pptxdk/capabilities` (`src/chart/test/fixtures/native-23-absent/`) retained in `pptxdk` for consumer `codegen` + `buildFromSource` acceptance tests without crossing package boundaries. They verify empty chart series (`[]`), explicit missing values (`null`), zero values (`0`), workbook-to-cache mismatches, and UI-rebound data ranges.

| File                              | Application (`docProps/app.xml`)      | SHA-256                                                            | Role in tests                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `23-absent-pp-untouched.pptx`     | Microsoft Office PowerPoint `16.0000` | `72912ea68f0b376146ee8e3d85cf402b154c98fdb5789320b76f979811d0407a` | Saved untouched after opening; retains zero-source series without injecting cache observations; used to verify `[]` vs `null` vs `0` import and filling empty series after zeroing input bytes. |
| `23-absent-pp-filled-cells.pptx`  | Microsoft Office PowerPoint `16.0000` | `f6bb4bcdce2067aacdbd750a40fe1e81e279b730a7cd91f2131131797ba19865` | Embedded workbook cells populated without rebinding series formulas; verifies `chart-workbook-mismatch` reporting and `[]` vs `null` vs `0` preservation.                                       |
| `23-absent-pp-filled-range.pptx`  | Microsoft Office PowerPoint `16.0000` | `d37156b2bd8bd67c8bba12e3eb41adaa62f3bfde6185fa319b793a22db0a10e1` | Embedded workbook cells populated and series ranges rebound; verifies reading `["A", "B"]` / `[3, 7]`, pie `["One", "Two"]` / `[2, 5]`, and scatter XY `[2, 5]` / `[4, 1]`.                     |
| `23-absent-wps-untouched.pptx`    | WPS Presentation `14.0000`            | `fc80e861b7092fcfb3fb23ae6f799186eefdaead9bf83d0080552cbc16ae0696` | Saved untouched in WPS; retains zero-source series without injecting observations; used to verify `[]` vs `null` vs `0` import and filling empty series after zeroing input bytes.              |
| `23-absent-wps-filled-cells.pptx` | WPS Presentation `14.0000`            | `ac8b373aff1ab9284fb88c74518d5c1442ee29e77a5d1214e595bb9f18e24954` | Embedded workbook cells populated in WPS without rebinding series formulas; verifies `chart-workbook-mismatch` reporting and `[]` vs `null` vs `0` preservation.                                |
| `23-absent-wps-series-ui.pptx`    | WPS Presentation `14.0000`            | `4787cd57af84b24f977a6f69e3433e144b7158521b3325bfe63b499a4af13001` | Rebound via WPS chart series UI; verifies reading `["A", "B"]` categories and `[3, 7]` values on slide 1.                                                                                       |
